verdict.rationale: Decagon's testing-qa docs describe generating test cases (decagon-docs-11) but never mention a sandboxed environment separate from production; its Experiments feature explicitly states results are measured 'directly in production' (decagon-docs-7), suggesting no isolated sandbox flow for testing changes without touching live data. No pack item describes a staging/sandbox environment, test/production data separation, or a way to validate agents before production traffic.
